slides.headline: He went to school in Delhi. Now he runs one of America's biggest phone companies.
Srini Gopalan became CEO of T-Mobile US, succeeding Mike Sievert
slides.body: Born and raised in Delhi, he attended Delhi Public School and St. Stephen's College before earning his MBA from IIM Ahmedabad - then built a career spanning Hindustan Unilever, Vodafone, Bharti Airtel, and CEO of Deutsche Telekom Germany before taking the top job at T-Mobile.

slides.headline: He's the second Indian-origin CEO to lead a major US telecom, after a career built across four continents.
slides.body: From COO to CEO at T-Mobile, Gopalan's path runs through Indian, European and American corporate cultures - a career built on moving between markets, not staying in one.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when a Delhi education becomes the foundation for running a Fortune 50 company.
slides.body: Gopalan's path is a reminder that India's management training pipeline - IIM included - is already producing leaders for companies far beyond India's borders.
